flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish (FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl, FurnishValidationServiceImpl, FurnishRequestValidator, FurnishSubmissionController/ServiceImpl) and crud/ocmspii/eocmsoffencenoticeownerdriver; ocmseserviceui route furnish-particulars. ocmsadminprivateapi: SyncInternetIntranetJobsScheduler + FurnishProcessingService + FurnishApprovalHelper (auto-approval, new offender, stage reset to RD1/DN1), SystemConstant.FURNISHABLE_STAGE_PAIRS, Toppan upload/download (stage chain RD1-DR3), application-prod.properties and cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: manual review and staff furnish exist but belong to OCMS41/OCMS42 stories and are not assessed here
note: Status in stories.json: Built - Has gap (3 points); demo_remark: 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars'. The core flow exists and runs end to end in code: the owner furnishes through the eService at stage ROV/ENA/RD1/RD2, a Pending application is stored in the PII DB, a cron every 10 minutes (enabled in prod) pulls and checks it, auto-approval makes the hirer/driver the active offender with the owner's address, then the stage is reset to RD1 (hirer) or DN1 (driver). Gaps: (1) the demo_remark flags a failure to read offender data from the encrypted PII DB, which cannot be proven from the repo; (2) Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so whether the stage rules match Appendix B: cannot verify from repo; (3) follow-up after the reset depends on the Toppan letters, whose SFTP upload is blocked by config in dev, uat, prod (application-prod.properties:86, OCMS-DF-2026-192) and on eNotification, whose cron is off (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); (4) from reading the code, the letter_address reset after the first letter does not know furnished_mail (to verify). This story overlaps with OCMS41/OCMS42 (eService furnish and staff review), which are assessed separately. Tickets used as hints: OCMS-DF-2026-067, OCMS-DF-2026-077, OCMS-DF-2026-110, OCMS-DF-2026-143, OCMS-DF-2026-137, OCMS-DF-2026-170, OCMS-DF-2026-192. Singpass/Corppass, property values in Azure, and PII DB contents: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: eService furnish through the RD1/DN1 stage reset exists in code; the PII DB, Appendix B and letter delivery to the vendor cannot be proven or are blocked by config

steps.step: Vehicle owner logs in to the Online Customer Portal and sees the list of their NOPOs that can be furnished
steps.detail: After login (JWT), POST v1/furnishapplicationlist without a status calls getEligibleNotices: it loads the offender records (offender_indicator Y) by ID, drops notices that already have a Pending application, reads notice details from eVON, then marks 'Eligible' when the owner is not a Driver and isNoticeEligibleForFurnish passes (FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl.java:78-150). The ID query uses the encrypted PII column (DecryptByKey, EocmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverRepository.java:66-80). The UI page is the furnish-particulars route (route.ts:38-40). Partial because the story demo_remark says 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars', i.e. reading offender data from the PII DB failed during the demo; whether the encryption key and PII DB access work in the environment: cannot verify from repo. Singpass/Corppass handshake: cannot verify from repo. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-067 and OCMS-DF-2026-077 (Closed, Prod deployed): furnishable notices were not shown because the LTA cron did not set is_sync = N; fixed.

steps.step: Only NOPOs at the pre-defined stages (ROV, ENA, RD1, RD2, including 1st and 2nd reminder) and not suspended can be furnished
steps.detail: ELIGIBLE_STAGES = ROV, ENA, RD1, RD2 (SystemConstant.java:112-113). isProcessingStageEligible checks last_processing_stage, with a fallback to next_processing_stage for RD1/RD2 only (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:175-183). getIneligibilityReason also rejects notices with crs_reason_of_suspension set, PS with reason DIP/MID/FOR/RIP/RP2, and type U (UPL) notices (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:186-216). This matches the 1st/2nd reminder examples in the story. The eService stage list is standalone; Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so whether the full list matches Appendix B: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Owner enters the hirer/driver particulars (name, ID, mailing address, phone, email, relationship to owner) and the form validates them
steps.detail: POST v1/furnishapplication (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66) takes the owner identity from the JWT, not from user input (79-84), then validator.validateAll checks mandatory fields, ID, email, phone, documents (99). validateSelfFurnish blocks an individual/company owner from furnishing themselves as hirer (FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:51-91); validateQAResponses blocks a driver without hirer details and a hirer without driver details (102-141). A company hirer (UEN, id_type B) is allowed (FurnishRequestValidator.java:107-115). Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-110 and OCMS-DF-2026-143 (Closed, Prod deployed): submission failed with 'Error occurred during submission' for some owners; closed. OCMS-DF-2026-137 (UEN) fixed ID type validation; does not change the assessment.

steps.step: The submitted particulars are saved as a furnish application with status Pending, together with the supporting documents
steps.detail: Each notice is validated (validateAllNoticesForSubmission, fail-all): the notice must be eligible, the user must be an offender and not a Driver, and there must be no Pending application (FurnishSubmissionController.java:134-165; FurnishValidationServiceImpl.java:302). mapToEntity fills name, ID, mailing address (blk, floor, street, unit, bldg, postal), phone, email, owner_driver_indicator, status 'P' and is_sync 'N' (FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.java:157-211), then saveAll to the PII DB and documents are moved to permanent storage (94-130).

steps.step: A cron pulls the application into the intranet, then auto-approves it when the checks pass; the rest go to manual review
steps.detail: SyncInternetIntranetScheduler runs every 10 minutes and is enabled in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:305-306); its job 1 runs FurnishProcessingJob (SyncInternetIntranetJobsScheduler.java:47, 67). processSingleSubmission runs 6 checks: active PS, HST ID, FIN/Passport, furnishable stage (last|next pair in FURNISHABLE_STAGE_PAIRS, SystemConstant.java:237-244), existing offender, and prior submission (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:183-226, 319-333). Passing means executeApproval; failing means executeManualReview: status Pending and TS-PDP (505-540; FurnishProcessingService.java:160-175). The staff manual review itself belongs to OCMS41 stories and is not assessed here.

steps.step: After approval, the hirer/driver is recorded as the active offender replacing the previous one, with the mailing address given by the owner
steps.detail: executeApproval calls addFurnishedOffender (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:445-460). switchOffenderIndicator changes the old offender_indicator from Y to N in intranet and internet (713-745), then a new owner_driver record is created with role H or D, offender_indicator Y, name, ID, email and phone from the furnish application (542-575). processFurnishedAddress sets letter_address = null on the old offender's addresses and stores the furnished_mail address with letter_address = 'Y' (601-636). The internet offender record (eONOD) does not carry email/phone (571-580). Note: the old offender's addresses for the same role are not deleted by this cron path; the staff-side furnish is the subject of OCMS-DF-2026-024 (Closed) in ocmsadminapi and is not assessed here.

steps.step: The NOPO stage is reset so follow-up goes to the hirer (RD1) or the driver (DN1)
steps.detail: changeProcessingStage: role H means stage RD1, role D means stage DN1; the old stage is kept in prev_processing_stage; last and next processing stage are set to the new stage; next_processing_date = max(notice_date + 7 days, tomorrow); administration_fee is reset to 0 and amount_payable = composition_amount (fix OCMS-DF-2026-170); then eVON is synced (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-711). So the NOPO no longer proceeds against the owner. The 7-day rule and the reset to RD1/DN1 compared with Appendix B Annex 1A: cannot verify from repo (document is not in the repo).

steps.step: The following automated processing workflow (letter reminders and notices per Appendix B) runs against the hirer or driver
steps.detail: The stage chain exists: ToppanStage RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (ToppanStage.java:19-26); ToppanDownloadJob documents the hirer/owner path RD1 to RD2 to RR3 and the driver path DN1 to DN2 to DR3 (ToppanDownloadJob.java:409-411); ToppanLettersGeneratorJob runs all stages in order (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-166). Partial because: (1) Appendix B Annex 1A is not in the repo, so the order, durations and actions per stage against Appendix B: cannot verify from repo; (2) sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev, uat, prod (application-prod.properties:86), so the letter file does not reach Toppan (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-209), yet the stage still advances through the delivery gate bypass (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-446), see OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT); (3) to verify, from reading the code: resetLetterAddressAfterToppan only picks mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:468-520), not furnished_mail, so a hirer/driver that only has furnished_mail loses letter_address = 'Y' after the first letter and may be filtered out by filterByLetterAddress (2372-2440) at the next stage unless MHA/DataHive adds a registered address; not proven by a run. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed) fixed the wrong admin fee on RD1 to RD1 and DN1 to DN1 transitions.
